# Build your application for Android
For information on the build process for Android and the tools Unity uses, refer to [How Unity builds Android applications](https://docs.unity3d.com/6000.5/Documentation/Manual/how-unity-builds-android-applications.html).

This is useful if you want more control over the build pipeline, want to see or modify the [Android App Manifest](https://docs.unity3d.com/6000.5/Documentation/Manual/android-manifest.html) that Unity generates for your application, or [integrate Unity-powered features into another Android application](https://docs.unity3d.com/6000.5/Documentation/Manual/UnityasaLibrary-Android.html). For more information, refer to [Exporting an Android project](https://docs.unity3d.com/6000.5/Documentation/Manual/android-export-process.html).

Unity includes multiple methods that you can use to optimize the install size. For more information, refer to [Optimize distribution size](https://docs.unity3d.com/6000.5/Documentation/Manual/android-optimize-distribution-size.html).

For more information, refer to [Application patching](https://docs.unity3d.com/6000.5/Documentation/Manual/android-AppPatching.html).

## Configure the build
See in [Glossary](https://docs.unity3d.com/6000.5/Documentation/Manual/Glossary.html#PlayerSettings): Configure runtime and build settings for the application.

- [Build settings](https://docs.unity3d.com/6000.5/Documentation/Manual/android-build-settings.html): Configure build system settings.

## Build the application
To build your Unity application for Android:

- If the **Split Application Binary** Player Setting is enabled and the **Build App Bundle (Google Play)** Build Setting is disabled, Unity builds [Android expansion files](https://docs.unity3d.com/6000.5/Documentation/Manual/android-OBBsupport.html) (OBB) for the APK and places them in the correct location on your device.

web.title: Unity Remote
web.description: Unity Remote supports Android, iOS, and tvOS devices. To use Unity Remote on an Android device, the Android SDK must be installed on your development computer.

web.title: Android requirements and compatibility
web.description: Unity supports Android 6.0 “Marshmallow” (API level 23) and above. You can now target Android API levels 35 and 36 in your Unity projects.
